title: [review] lib.rs: Channel can exceed n_channels when n_channels < 3
description: synchronized_hop_channel clamps n_channels to minimum 3 via .max(3), then returns 1 + (hash % n). When n_channels is 1 or 2, the returned channel (1-3) can exceed the caller's actual channel count, potentially causing out-of-bounds access in channel arrays. Consider returning (h % n_channels) + 1 directly, or documenting that callers must have at least 3 channels.
